welcome_description: Zephyr moves files between your devices and the people around you, directly and without a middleman. Let's get it set up, it only takes a minute.
share_shortcut_description: Select any file or folder, anywhere.
share_shortcut_hint: Press the shortcut above to continue
share_shortcut_linux_description: Zephyr's window comes up over whatever you're doing.
share_shortcut_linux_description_press: Drop your files in it, bring it up with
share_shortcut_linux_drag_file: Drag file into the Zephyr window
all_shortcuts_description: Everything Zephyr does, it does without interrupting you. Make each shortcut yours.
personal_devices_description: Files you send yourself just land. And more than files moves between them, like your clipboard.
personal_devices_warning: Only add devices you actually own
contacts_description: Nearby devices find each other automatically. For everyone else, a contact is all it takes.
notifications_and_sounds_description: Zephyr spends most of its time in the background. This is how it lets you know something arrived.
outro_description: You're all set. Zephyr's ready whenever you are.
